findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_lender_universe, get_lender_profile · Private data: get_mortgage_rates, get_start_link · Public sink: get_state_mortgage_free_homeownership · Destructive: get_loan_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_lender_universe, get_lender_profile · Private data: get_mortgage_rates, get_start_link · Public sink: get_state_mortgage_free_homeownership · Destructive: get_loan_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
